name: mern-learn
description: Free, open-source platform to learn the MERN stack from zero to mastery — curated resources, interactive playgrounds, progress tracking

paragraphs: A free, open-source learning platform that takes you from zero to MERN stack mastery — with a curated roadmap, hand-picked free resources, interactive code playgrounds, progress tracking, and community features.
features: Dual learning tracks — Beginner (starts from HTML/CSS/JS) and Developer (straight to MERN)
Curated free resources — 100+ hand-picked videos, articles, docs, and interactive courses. No paywalls, no affiliate links
Interactive playground — In-browser HTML/CSS/JS editor with live preview, plus one-click launches for Node, Express, React, and MongoDB environments via StackBlitz
Progress tracking — Lessons completed, XP, levels, streaks, badges, notes, and bookmarks. Stored locally with optional account sync
Dashboard — Track your journey across both tracks with stats, badges, and bookmarks

whatItDoes.text: A free, open-source learning platform that takes you from zero to MERN stack mastery — with a curated roadmap, hand-picked free resources, interactive code playgrounds, progress tracking, and community features.
